name: ModelVariant630_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant630_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (three volleys of glowing orbs arc from a model joint to points round a circle, each landing orb leaving a growing, fading sprite edged with shaded bands while columns of sparks drift out); for a non-negative request it reads the 0xA-byte command row indexed by the request for the start delay, sprite size and orb colour, seeds the orbs, rings and sparks and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while a ring is active, 1 on the first frame with every element inactive and 2 after that; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-647 and 714 images build it through french_model_variant/variant647_entry.c without the work-size printf and its string and bind its data names 0x28 lower; the Japanese slot-1 images keep a wrapper only for the format-string padding byte. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
